description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseMessage' used for API requests within the Microsoft.eShopWeb project. It provides a GUID for correlation purposes, initialized at creation.

classes.name: BaseMessage
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for API request messages, containing a GUID for correlation identification.

methods.name: CorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the GUID correlation ID associated with the message.
